integrity: The global inequality is proved analytically by two point evaluations and an exact factorization. Numerical sampling is corroborative only and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Continuous real trigonometric-polynomial problem only; no discrete-grid or arbitrary sparse-support formula is claimed. Older differently indexed cosine-polynomial literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact Carathéodory–Fejér constant for the three lowest odd harmonics
